task.description: Cook one raw shrimp from a checkpoint near an Al Kharid range.

startState.notes: Install before each episode with: bun experiments/load-save.ts McPlan runs/checkpoints/McPlan-cook-shrimp-alkharid.sav --api http://localhost:8888. Then relog with: bun sdk/cli.ts McPlan --server localhost --timeout 15000 --launch.

goalState.description: Inventory gains cooked Shrimps and Cooking XP increases.

initialDomainModel.description: Cook one raw shrimp near an Al Kharid range.
notes: Classical effect is the successful cooking branch; execution must tolerate stochastic burned output and retry.
Classical effect is the successful cooking branch; execution must tolerate stochastic burned output and retry.
Cooking is stochastic at low level. Using Raw shrimps on a Range can produce Shrimps or Burnt fish.
A failed stochastic outcome is not an invalid action if Raw shrimps were consumed and Burnt fish appeared.

actions.description: Use a raw shrimp on a nearby range or fire to cook it.

actions.description: Bounded recovery action that scans, opens obvious doors/gates, and walks short probes to find a reachable Range or Fire.
